prompt.en: Meera takes a living parenchyma cell from the stem of a tulsi plant. She places it in a nutrient medium with sugars and hormones, in suitable conditions. Predict what the cell may do, and give two reasons.

level1.en: Is a parenchyma cell alive or dead? Why does that matter here?

clue.en: Only a living cell, with its cytoplasm and nucleus, can regain the ability to divide.

level2Template.en: The cell can divide again because it is ___.

label.en: It can form a whole plant

level1.en: What did Steward's carrot cells show that some mature plant cells can do in such a medium?

clue.en: Some mature plant cells are totipotent: they can dedifferentiate, divide and redifferentiate into a whole plant.

level2Template.en: It may grow into a whole tulsi plant because some mature plant cells are ___.

accepted: able to grow into a whole plant
able to form a whole plant

text.en: The parenchyma cell is alive, so it can regain the ability to divide and form a mass of cells.
Some mature plant cells are totipotent, so the mass may redifferentiate into roots and a shoot and grow into a whole tulsi plant.
